The '''Mobetta system''' was located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was apparently one of the more industrialized Airam systems.

The Rebel [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|starship component factory]] [[Soren]] and the Airam [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Gallofree]] were located in this system.

''Soren'' was discovered and quickly [[Attack on Soren|destroyed]] by [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]].

At ''Gallofree'' the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] transferred the [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] from the stolen [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' to the [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']], thereby creating the first [[Modified Strike Cruiser]].

The Rebels had to fight off [[First attack on the Peregrine|several]] [[Second attack on the Peregrine|Imperial attacks]] until the ''Peregrine'' was completed and successfully tested. Grateful for the help of their Airam allies, the Rebels successfully defended the factory in the [[retreat from Gallofree]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although a timeline of the Rebel and Imperial missions is not given in the game, the First Battle of Mobetta (Imperial Campaign, mission #5) took place prior to the capture of the INT ''Compellor'' and before [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] received their [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s, and therefore prior to the three battles in the Rebel Campaign (missions #8, 9 and 11).
